content: MacroFactor weekly coaching loop: expenditure algorithm at the heart of the product adjusts weekly calorie and macro targets from weight trend and intake (V3 algorithm article, Oct 2024); weekly review rhythm plus analytics (trend weight, expenditure, energy balance, adherence) is its core differentiator versus static target apps. For Flex Diet the manual analog is the pushed weekly WhatsApp report with adherence, workouts, supplements and weight; automatic expenditure adjustment stays out of scope by design.
